name: todo-list
description: Local day-by-day todo timeline for dlient: create, schedule, update, complete and delete tasks with start/due dates and priorities. All data is stored in the plugin's own data folder.

tools.name: todo-list.state
tools.description: Read every todo plus aggregate stats (total / active / completed / overdue / dueToday / todayActive / unscheduled / percent). No arguments.

tools.name: todo-list.add
tools.description: Create a todo. `startAt` decides which day of the timeline it lands on (defaults to today). Returns the full updated state.

startAt.description: Start date as a local-midnight epoch-ms timestamp; omitted = today, null = unscheduled

dueAt.description: Due date as a local-midnight epoch-ms timestamp

tools.name: todo-list.update
tools.description: Patch an existing todo (only the provided fields change), including moving it to another day via `startAt`. Returns the full updated state.

startAt.description: Start date; null moves it to the unscheduled column

tools.name: todo-list.toggle
tools.description: Complete / reopen a todo. Omit `done` to flip the current value. Returns the full updated state.

tools.name: todo-list.remove
tools.description: Delete one todo by id. Returns the full updated state.

tools.name: todo-list.clearCompleted
tools.description: Delete every completed todo at once. Returns the full updated state.
